userStories.title: Prisma Schema mit allen Models und Indexes
userStories.description: Erstelle das vollständige Datenbankschema mit 6 Models, Enums, Relations, Unique Constraints und Indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: Führe aus: cd fpz-leadfinder && npx prisma init --datasource-provider sqlite

Ersetze prisma/schema.prisma mit exakt diesem Inhalt:

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum LeadStatus {
  NEW
  CONTACTED
  OFFER_SENT
  WON
  REJECTED
  ARCHIVED
}

enum LeadSource {
  OSM
  GOOGLE_MAPS
  MANUAL
}

enum EffortLevel {
  SMALL
  MEDIUM
  LARGE
}

model Lead {
  id            String          @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  address       String
  city          String
  zip           String?
  phone         String?
  email         String?
  website       String?
  category      String
  subcategory   String?
  googleMapsUrl String?
  openingHours  String?
  latitude      Float?
  longitude     Float?
  source        LeadSource      @default(OSM)
  status        LeadStatus      @default(NEW)
  overallScore  Int?
  notes         String?
  createdAt     DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime        @updatedAt
  analysis      WebsiteAnalysis?
  briefing      Briefing?
  salesScript   SalesScript?

  @@unique([name, address, city])
  @@index([city])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([overallScore])
  @@index([category])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

Füge Model WebsiteAnalysis hinzu:

model WebsiteAnalysis {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  leadId             String   @unique
  lead               Lead     @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  performanceScore   Int      @default(0)
  seoScore           Int      @default(0)
  mobileScore        Int      @default(0)
  securityScore      Int      @default(0)
  designScore        Int      @default(0)
  techScore          Int      @default(0)
  ageScore           Int      @default(0)
  accessibilityScore Int      @default(0)
  contentScore       Int      @default(0)
  overallScore       Int      @default(0)
  details            String?  // JSON string
  screenshotUrl      String?
  techStack          String?  // JSON string
  analyzedAt         DateTime @default(now())
}

Füge Model Briefing hinzu:

model Briefing {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  leadId      String      @unique
  lead        Lead        @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  summary     String
  weaknesses  String      // JSON string: Array<{ title: string, severity: string, description: string }>
  suggestions String      // JSON string: Array<{ title: string, description: string, service: string }>
  effort      EffortLevel @default(MEDIUM)
  opener      String
  riskScore   Int         @default(5)
  fullText    String
  generatedAt DateTime    @default(now())
}

Füge Model SalesScript hinzu:

model SalesScript {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  leadId        String   @unique
  lead          Lead     @relation(fields: [leadId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  greeting      String
  hook          String
  painPoints    String   // JSON string: string[]
  solution      String
  callToAction  String
  objections    String   // JSON string: Array<{ objection: string, response: string }>
  fullScript    String
  generatedAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

Füge Model ScanLog hinzu:

model ScanLog {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  cities       String    // JSON string: string[]
  newLeads     Int       @default(0)
  updatedLeads Int       @default(0)
  errors       Int       @default(0)
  duration     Int       @default(0) // Sekunden
  status       String    @default("running") // running | completed | failed
  startedAt    DateTime  @default(now())

Füge Model Settings hinzu:

model Settings {
  id                String   @id @default("default")

userStories.description: Erstelle den OSM Scraper der Unternehmen aus der Overpass API für alle 20 Ruhrgebiet-Städte extrahiert.

const OVERPASS_API = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

function buildOverpassQuery(cityName: string): string — Baut diese Query: `[out:json][timeout:60]; area[name="${cityName}"][admin_level~"6|8"]->.city; ( node["shop"](area.city); node["office"](area.city); node["amenity"~"restaurant|cafe|bar|fast_food|pharmacy|doctors|dentist|veterinary|bank|fuel|driving_school"](area.city); node["craft"](area.city); node["healthcare"](area.city); node["tourism"~"hotel|guest_house"](area.city); ); out body;`

function parseOSMNode(node: OSMNode): ScrapedLead | null — Extrahiert: name aus node.tags?.name (return null wenn kein name), address aus node.tags?.['addr:street'] + ' ' + (node.tags?.['addr:housenumber'] ?? '') (return null wenn kein addr:street), city aus node.tags?.['addr:city'] ?? cityName (Parameter), zip aus node.tags?.['addr:postcode'], phone aus node.tags?.phone ?? node.tags?.['contact:phone'], email aus node.tags?.email ?? node.tags?.['contact:email'], website aus node.tags?.website ?? node.tags?.['contact:website']. Kategorie: Bestimme aus Tags — wenn node.tags?.shop → category = OSM_CATEGORY_MAP[node.tags.shop] ?? node.tags.shop, subcategory = node.tags.shop. Analog für amenity, craft, office, healthcare, tourism. latitude = node.lat, longitude = node.lon.

export async function scrapeOSM(cities: City[]): Promise<{ leads: ScrapedLead[]; errors: string[] }> — Iteriert über cities. Pro Stadt: 1) fetch(OVERPASS_API, { method: 'POST', body: 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(buildOverpassQuery(city.name)), headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000) }). 2) Parse JSON response: response.elements als Array. 3) Map jedes element durch parseOSMNode, filter nulls. 4) Zwischen Städten: await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000)) — 5 Sekunden Pause (Overpass Fair Use). 5) Bei Fehler (429, 503, Timeout): logge in errors Array, überspringe Stadt, mache weiter.
Return: { leads: alle ScrapedLeads gesammelt, errors: Array von Error-Messages }.
Type-Definition für OSM Response: interface OSMNode { type: string; id: number; lat: number; lon: number; tags?: Record<string, string>; }. interface OSMResponse { elements: OSMNode[]; }.
